svg.title: FemTech Weekend, built by Chan Meng as the community’s Chief Technology Officer and sole architect of both generations of its platform: the bilingual website and sign-up system that carried Shanghai Summit 2026. English and Simplified Chinese on every page, the summit’s agenda and programme, four application forms feeding one reviewed pipeline; 538 of 570 commits to 30 July 2026 and 16 server endpoints.
